meta.title: DevInterview – Tech Interview Practice
meta.description: Learn and practice tech interviews: Frontend, Backend, AI/ML, DevOps, System Design…

dashboard.countdownToday: Your interview is today — good luck!
dashboard.noDate: Set your interview date to track your prep time:
dashboard.streakHint: Study every day to keep it going
dashboard.planPick: Pick a learning path to study systematically
dashboard.continueEmpty: Start a learning path: go from basics to advanced, rate yourself on each question and review with flashcards.
dashboard.allDone: You have practiced every question in this field 🎉

questions.select: Pick a question from the list to start practicing.
questions.tryFirst: Answer it yourself first (out loud or in the draft box below), then open the answer — you will remember much more.
questions.noFollowUps: No follow-up questions for this one yet.

flashcards.subtitle: Spaced repetition: hard cards come back soon, easy ones less often.
flashcards.summary: This session: {total} cards ({due} due, the rest are new). Up to {max} cards per session.
flashcards.keysHint: Shortcuts: Space to flip, 1 / 2 / 3 to rate
flashcards.doneText: You reviewed {n} cards. Come back tomorrow to keep your streak.

roadmap.subtitle: Learn each field in order, from fundamentals to advanced.

interview.subtitle: Pick a role and level, and the AI will interview you like a real session.
interview.codePlaceholder: // Write code to back up your answer…
interview.codeHint: Code is attached to your next answer — the AI reads it, asks follow-ups and grades it. Tab = indent, Ctrl+Enter = send.
interview.missingKey: GEMINI_API_KEY is not set. Create .env.local as described in the README.
interview.noSpeech: This browser doesn't support speech recognition, please use Chrome or Edge.

project.title: Project Deep-dive
project.subtitle: AI reads your repo / CV and asks questions like a real interviewer
project.analyzing: AI is reading your project… (about 30–60 seconds)
project.interviewSubtitle: The AI will dig into your project. Pick the role and level you're applying for.
project.empty: Paste a public GitHub repo link or upload your CV (PDF) — the AI analyzes the tech stack, strengths / risks and suggests questions tied to specific code files.
project.needInput: Enter a GitHub repo link or choose a CV file.
project.tooBig: CV file must be 3 MB or smaller.

errors.missing_key: GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured. Create .env.local as described in the README.
errors.repo_not_found: Repo not found (it must be public).
errors.github_rate_limit: GitHub rate limit reached, try again in a few minutes (or add GITHUB_TOKEN to .env.local).
